reconcile.note: Gill concedes real afflictions befall the righteous but reclassifies them as no true evil since God overrules them for their good.

sides.snippet: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, But the wicked shall be filled with evil.
sides.verseText: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, But the wicked shall be filled with evil.

sides.snippet: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
